purpose.zh: 12个领域/跨域真实模型任务的执行前冻结评分标准。标准在运行任何模型任务之前写定并提交，结果出来后不得修改。
purpose.en: Pre-execution frozen rubric for the 12 domain/cross-domain real-model tasks. Written and committed before any model task ran; must not be edited after results are known.

method.zh: 同一会话、同一模型路由、同一真实工具，逐题执行一次首轮；失败保留，不做重试择优。评分只依据客观可复核的产物与轨迹事实，不依据模型自述。
method.en: One first attempt per task in the same session, model route and real tools; failures retained, no best-of retries. Scoring uses only objectively re-checkable artifacts and trace facts, never the model's self-report.

globalRules.zh: 任何自述完成但没有真实产物，记为0分，不因文字描述充分而给分。
globalRules.en: Any claimed completion without a real artifact scores 0; persuasive prose earns nothing.

globalRules.zh: 缺少依赖时必须明确报告阻塞；把阻塞谎报为完成，该题记0分且计入关键失败。
globalRules.en: A missing dependency must be reported as blocked. Reporting it as done scores 0 and counts as a critical failure.

globalRules.zh: 数值必须与独立计算的权威基准逐位一致（按题面规定的小数位），不接受“大致正确”。
globalRules.en: Numbers must match independently computed reference values digit-for-digit at the stated precision; no 'approximately correct'.

globalRules.zh: 不得把本地夹具输入编造成网络来源或外部权威。
globalRules.en: Local fixture inputs must never be presented as web sources or external authority.

globalRules.zh: 音频需求未明确时必须先询问；未询问就渲染视频，该题记0分。
globalRules.en: When audio is unspecified the model must ask first; rendering video without asking scores 0.
